details:
日本時間の2026/10/04より、VRChatのDesktopモードで、周期的に大きなFPS低下が発生しています。

およそ10秒に1回程度、VRChatアプリ全体が約1秒間停止したような状態になり、その後すぐに通常のフレームレートへ戻ります。

他のアプリケーションは停止しません。

この停止時にはGPU使用率が上昇するのではなく、逆に低下します。通常時のGPU使用率は約20%ですが、FPS低下時には約0～7%まで低下します。同時にCPU使用率も大きく低下します。

このフリーズはどのワールドでも、一人のインスタンスでも発生しています。

システム情報

VRChat Build: 2026.3.3-1919-27c41b24d2-Release

Unity Version: 6000.0.67f1-DWR

Mode: Desktop / --no-vr

CPU: Intel Core i3-12100

GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 8GB

RAM: 約24GB

OS: Windows 11

Graphics API: Direct3D 11

Output Log内の関連数値

最低FPS: 0.851

CPU frame time 最大: 1.17319秒

input latency 最大: 1173.811ms

GPU frame time 最大: 0.00555秒

English

Title

Periodic ~1 second FPS drops in Desktop mode while CPU/GPU utilization decreases

Description

I am experiencing severe periodic FPS drops in VRChat Desktop mode.

Approximately once every 10 seconds, the game appears to stall for around one second, after which the framerate immediately returns to normal.

During the stall, GPU utilization decreases instead of increasing. In my case, GPU utilization is normally around 20%, but during the FPS drop it falls to approximately 0–7%. CPU utilization also decreases significantly at the same time.

The issue occurs even when I do not move or touch the mouse, so it does not appear to be related to mouse polling/input activity.

The VRChat output log also appears to capture the stall. The recorded Performance Stats show a maximum CPU frame time of approximately 1.173 seconds and maximum input latency of approximately 1173.8 ms, while the maximum GPU frame time is only approximately 5.55 ms. The minimum recorded FPS is approximately 0.851.

The issue also reproduces in a private instance with no other users present.

1. Launch VRChat in Desktop mode.

2. Enter a world and remain in the instance normally.

3. Do not provide any mouse input.

4. Observe the framerate and CPU/GPU utilization for approximately 30–60 seconds.

5. Approximately every 10 seconds, a severe FPS drop/stall occurs.

6. After roughly one second, performance returns to normal until the next occurrence.

Expected behavior

Framerate should remain stable when the scene and workload are otherwise unchanged.

Actual behavior

VRChat periodically stalls for approximately one second. During the stall, both CPU and GPU utilization decrease substantially, and GPU utilization can temporarily fall close to 0%.

The application then recovers without crashing.

System information

VRChat Build: 2026.3.3-1919-27c41b24d2-Release

Unity Version: 6000.0.67f1-DWR

Mode: Desktop / --no-vr

CPU: Intel Core i3-12100

GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 8GB

RAM: approximately 24GB

OS: Windows 11

Graphics API: Direct3D 11

Relevant output log statistics

Minimum FPS: 0.851

Maximum CPU frame time: 1.17319 s

Maximum input latency: 1173.811 ms

Maximum GPU frame time: 0.00555 s
